description: Mésozoplancton dans l'Escaut maritime entre 1995 et 1996 is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. Quantitative and qualitative study on mesozooplankton species in the Sea Scheldt between 1995 and 1996. The data were digitized by VLIZ from the original report: Van Mieghem, R. (1996). Mesozooplankton in de Zeeschelde. BSc Thesis. Vrije Universiteit Brussel: Brussel. 28, + annexes pp. Coverage: Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. The portal shows the English title as "Mesozooplankton in the Sea Scheldt between 1995 and 1996" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. Its keywords include biodiversiteit, biodiversité, Biodiversität, biodiversity. The listing shows 1 download or service links in DWCA. The listing shows 2024-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
